## The problem this unit solves

Choose a practice environment and run Python work reproducibly.

## Questions to carry through the unit

- What concrete problem does this concept solve?
- What should you predict before running the example?
- What evidence would show that your explanation is correct?

## Lessons in this unit

1. [What Is Programming?](what-is-programming.qmd)
2. [Google Colab](google-colab.qmd)
3. [Local Python Tools](local-python-tools.qmd)

Work through the lessons in order. Keep one prediction, one controlled change,
and one debugging note from each lesson.
